The sole shipped original is a different-titled 1980 journal article, Culture and Organizations. The supplied factual report confirms that its journal body, sample and specific finding could not be verified, so the evidence cannot establish whether that article reports the same IBM uncertainty-avoidance finding or is a distinct work. Needed: the 1980 journal article body/front matter and empirical content sufficient to compare its sample and UA finding with the cited book.
records.omission_quote: In this article, we present such a replication of UA.

records.reason: The paper explicitly reports that its new undergraduate sample retests the positive spirituality associations with physical health, emotional health and exercise/sports attributed to Nelms et al. The source reference supplies DOI 10.1007/s10943-006-9075-0, matching shipped row 2284 exactly; that row is the same 2007 Journal of Religion and Health work despite its deposited 2006 DOI/year component.
records.omission_quote:
In keeping with the findings of Nelms et al. (2007), we found that
undergraduate students’ self-reported higher level of spirituality was positively related to student self-
reported level of physical health, emotional health, and exercise/sports.
